thread:
Aisha: Hey team! Downsizing my desk setup giving away 2x GA tickets to the SF Symphony (Saturday 7pm) + a small Ikea BEKANT standing desk (120x60cm, some surface marks). Free to a good home, pickup from SoMa office.
Ben: Interested in the desk! Is it the sit-stand frame or fixed?
Aisha: It's the electric sit-stand frame with the original crank removed (works fine with motor). I'll include the power brick and the smaller cable.
Ravi: Tickets sound great. Any restrictions or are they physical?
Aisha: E-tickets, I can transfer via email/Ticketmaster. No restrictions.
Clara (she/her): I can take the tickets if no one else jumps on them. Planning to be in SF that weekend.
Ben: Can you measure the tabletop thickness? My clamp monitor arm needs <3cm.
Aisha: Top is 2.2cm, melamine. Happy to leave foam pads if you need to protect it during moving.
Ravi: if Clara wants the tix I can take the desk, but I'll need help disassembling / carrying. Anyone around Fri evening?
Clara (she/her): I'll take the tickets. Aisha DM me your email and I'll accept the transfer.
Aisha: DM sent. Tickets transferred  got a confirmation email at 1768600100.
ops-bot: Reminder: donated or transferred office-related items should be logged on the office-transfers sheet. Please add: item, recipient, pickup date. http://intranet/office-transfers
Aisha: Thanks ops-bot  added row and tagged Facilities.
Ben: I'm happy to help Ravi with disassembly Friday 6pm. Can we meet at loading dock?
Ravi: Awesome thanks Ben. I'll bring tools and a dolly.
Aisha: If anyone wants the desk top only (IKEA pick-me-up style) I'm fine with that too  otherwise it's one piece. First come first serve.
Clara (she/her): Concert crew: anyone else in for pre-show drinks? :)
Ben: Good luck with the move Aisha!
Aisha: Thanks all  leaving a sticky on it at the desk so Facilities knows it's spoken for.
